column1: # INV-T-6019. Identifiers in backticks in the published behavior and intent of INV-REQ-325, 326, 474, 475, 476, 478, 503, 810
# (read from Keel). One row per identifier, under the first requirement that names it.
# INV-T-10711. Not listed, because the backticked names of the implemented requirements and criteria that are not rows are:
# 422 (a status code); tax.approver and tenant.admin (roles); access-svc (a service); OVERRIDABLE (a disposition value of the error catalogue);
# authorise, recordSoleOperator and withdrawSoleOperatorAcknowledgement (operations of access/openapi.yaml, owned by the access contract tasks);
# setPolicy and acknowledgeControlRelaxation (operations of service-runtime/openapi.yaml); AuthorityReplica.decide and validation.override
# (a library method and a catalogue key; the service task INV-T-10713 owns them).
# Earlier note: not listed, because they are not payload contract identifiers: tax.approver (role); masterdata-svc, payload-svc,
# evidence-svc (services); POST /v1/pre-issuance-checks and POST /v1/issuances (ingestion-svc's public routes);
# 422 and 503 (status codes); networkIssuance (submission contract); netTotal, taxTotal, grossTotal, amountDue
# (canonical contract, INV-REQ-810: payload never recomputes totals).
# INV-T-6329. tax.operator and entity.admin are roles, and EvidenceArtefactRecorded is service-runtime's event; none is an element of this contract.
